page.overview:
What is Shao Kahn's Staff?

Shao Kahn's Staff, also called the Staff of Shao Kahn, is a silver sceptre holding a ruby red orb that is another deadly weapon of Shao Kahn. This cursed red ball was introduced in Mortal Kombat II, Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3, Mortal Kombat Trilogy and Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks. The Staff of Shao Kahn was also endowed with the magic of the Emperor himself, although to date he has never been seen physically using the staff in any capacity.

In Mortal Kombat 11, staff appears in Krypt Kollector Items.
